Create external worktree D:/Code/Git/ImmortalWrt-C8-660-SMS-Refactor on branch codex/sms-forward-refactor from HEAD f97b925d9808ee34b3660ae122df024ebaa31bdd, apply C:/Users/Administrator/AppData/Local/Temp/c8-sms-user-worktree.patch, and prove a clean reproducible baseline matching exactly the 11 tracked modifications in the main workspace.
